title: undercooked unusual thai mussels pad thai
description: a bitter and chewy southern thai dish featuring mussels, with a low-fat emulsified sauce. serves as a filling snack or light dinner.
instructions: heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until softened.
add the mussels and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to open.
add the fish sauce, tamarind paste, brown sugar, and rice vinegar. stir to combine.
in a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and a splash of water until smooth.
add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the mussels are cooked through.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
transfer the mussels and sauce to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions.
serve immediately, over a bed of steamed rice if desired.
